why: Public PDFs contain judges, attorneys, agency officials, monitors, officers, and members of the public; URL accession must not become person extraction.
rules: Do not create any person entity from a document header, signature block, footnote, comment, or narrative in the DOJ pilot.
Attorney/judge names may be treated as citation context only if a future citation schema requires it; not as police-misconduct entities.
Officer names in court orders or monitor reports require separate privacy, due-process, and entity-resolution gates before any person record.
Civilian names, family names, witness names, commenters, minors, survivors, and vulnerable-community members remain protected from extraction by default.
